findings.text: the annular branch returns shells only when both outline_inner and outline_outer are filled, so an annular vessel unit with just one of the two populated (a representation the IMAS wall IDS permits) falls through to the centreline/outline fallback and the filled skin is silently dropped, rendering nothing for that unit.
